name: Tehran
description: Tamar is a Mossad hacker-agent who infiltrates Tehran under a false identity to help destroy Iran's nuclear reactor. But when her mission fails, Tamar must plan an operation that will place everyone dear to her in jeopardy.

videos.title: The Truth behind "Tehran"
videos.overview: Behind the scenes of the first season.

videos.title: Emergency Landing in Tehran
videos.overview: Tamar Rabinyan, a gifted hacker and a Mossad agent, enters the heart of Tehran to neutralize army radar systems and enable Israel's air force to bomb Iran's nuclear reactor.

videos.title: Blood on Her Hands
videos.overview: Tabrizi, a local Mossad agent, tries to help Tamar in any way possible, while Revolutionary Guard officer Faraz is hot on Tamar's trail.

videos.title: Yasamin's Girl
videos.overview: Hiding with her aunt, Tamar goes underground and attempts to escape Iran. Faraz and Tabrizi broaden their searches for her.

videos.title: Shakira and Sickboy
videos.overview: When she finds a commune of young regime opponents, Tamar takes refuge with them—and becomes close with Milad.

videos.title: The Other Iran
videos.overview: At an underground rave with Milad and the other commune members, Tamar must prove her loyalty. Faraz and Tabrizi reach a boiling point.

videos.title: The Engineer
videos.overview: Tamar and Milad return to Tehran and blackmail their electric company contact. Kadosh tries to convince Gorev to approve Tamar's new plan.

videos.title: Tamar's Father
videos.overview: The incident at the commune leaves Tamar shattered. Kadosh tries to help her recover so they can set the power plant operation in motion.

videos.title: Five Hours Until the Bombing Run
videos.overview: With Israeli planes approaching the reactor, Tamar, Milad, and Kadosh launch an operation as Faraz closes in on them.
Free of the Mossad and preparing to start a new life in Canada, Tamar is drawn back in by an irresistible offer.

videos.title: Change of Plan
videos.overview: A distraught Tamar chooses to stay in Tehran and seek justice—but learns the Mossad has put Marjan Montazemi in charge.

videos.title: PTSD
videos.overview: Determined to neutralize Faraz, Marjan makes a risky move. Tamar finds a way to get closer to Mohammadi. Milad begins behaving irresponsibly.

videos.title: The Rich Kids
videos.overview: Tamar attends an elite pool party to target Peyman. Marjan reconsiders the orders she's been given about Faraz.

videos.title: Double Fault
videos.overview: When Milad is arrested by Tehran police, Tamar and Faraz each race to reach him. Going against orders, Tamar continues pursuing Mohammadi.

videos.title: Faraz's Choice
videos.overview: In a dire situation, Faraz makes a difficult decision. Tamar and Peyman continue getting closer as Milad begins to question her priorities.

videos.title: Betty
videos.overview: Peyman tells Tamar about his father's car race, leading the Mossad to devise a plan to take out Mohammadi once and for all.

videos.title: Blood Funeral
videos.overview: Tamar doesn't know who to trust. A cat-and-mouse game leads to deadly consequences.

videos.title: Fightback
videos.overview: Fleeing pressure from her own side, Tamar hides out before making a vital discovery. Faraz and Nahid consider what to do next.

videos.title: Friend or Foe
videos.overview: Tamar calls on an old enemy for help before meeting her match. Faraz feels the squeeze. Peterson faces disaster.

videos.title: The Lion's Den
videos.overview: Finding herself in a tight spot, Tamar uses it to her advantage. Nahid makes a pact. Peterson turns up where he shouldn't be.

videos.title: Into the Fire
videos.overview: The fallout continues as Peterson's situation worsens. Nahid becomes more desperate as Tamar is forced closer to Ramin.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Faraz makes a surprising offer. Tamar and Nissan contemplate what lies ahead.

videos.title: Man of Business
videos.overview: Tamar and Nissan regroup after a shocking setback. Faraz's prospects improve but Nahid feels the walls close in. Peterson gets to work.

videos.title: Duress Test
videos.overview: As Peterson gets closer to his goal, Tamar recruits an unlikely ally. Nahid does what she must. Nissan confronts his past.

videos.title: Day Zero
videos.overview: Peterson approaches his endgame. Grappling with difficult choices and stark consequences, Tamar and Faraz face off.
